detail.longDescription: We’re migrating a public e-commerce SPA (Vite + S3 + CloudFront) to a backend where all API Gateway endpoints require an authorizer. We want raw requests to the protected API to return "401". However, product browsing must remain anonymous, and no credentials or tokens can be exposed to the browser. We also need stable, CDN-cacheable product image URLs and protection against bot traffic/unbounded AWS costs. What is the recommended AWS architecture to expose anonymous, cacheable storefront data while keeping the actual backend APIs fully protected?
